boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain George Mason University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Fairfax-area food stops with currently posted late hours.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell, 12811 Federal Systems Park Dr
cards.title: Taco Bell at Federal Systems Park
cards.subtitle: 12811 Federal Systems Park Dr, Fairfax
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late option; confirm the day’s posted hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax drive-thru with service extending into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 3 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 12811 Federal Systems Park Dr
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 7 AM–3 AM Sunday–Thursday; 7 AM–4 AM Friday–Saturday. Dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Wendy's on Braddock Road
cards.subtitle: 10695A Braddock Road, Fairfax
cards.notes: Choose carryout or drive-thru for a straightforward food stop after evening campus commitments.
cards.short_summary: An all-week Fairfax fast-food option with 2 AM posted closing.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are posted 6:30 AM–2 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: McDonald's on Jermantown Road
cards.subtitle: 4040 Jermantown Rd, Fairfax
cards.notes: Check whether it is a weekday or weekend before heading out, since the posted overnight schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax McDonald's with midnight weekday service and 24-hour weekend listing.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists midnight closing Monday–Thursday and Sunday, with 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru service Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru: until midnight most days; posted as 24 hours Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: McDonald's on Lee Jackson Memorial Highway
cards.subtitle: 13003 Lee Jackson Memorial Highway, Fairfax
cards.notes: Use this as a later-hours backup and check the official location page for the day-specific schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax location with late restaurant and drive-thru hours, including 24-hour weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 AM most days, 4 AM Thursday, and 24 hours Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours vary by day: 2 AM most days, 4 AM Thursday, and 24 hours Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Denny's on Lee Highway
cards.subtitle: 10473 Lee Highway, Fairfax
cards.notes: Plan for a sit-down or pickup meal, and review the official page before travel for any holiday changes.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax diner whose official listing runs nearly all day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Denny's page lists store hours of 12 AM–11:58 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Officially posted hours are 12 AM–11:58 PM daily; online-order availability can differ.

cards.title: Cafe K
cards.subtitle: 3040 Williams Dr, Suite 102, Fairfax
cards.notes: Use the posted schedule to time a late café-style stop, especially because weekend opening times differ.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax café listing 2 AM closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe K's official site lists closing at 2 AM daily, with varying opening times.
cards.access_notes: Posted close is 2 AM daily; opens at 8 AM Monday–Friday and 5 PM Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Pan Am Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 3051 Nutley St, Fairfax
cards.notes: Order pickup ahead if that suits your timing, then recheck the business page before a late trip.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax restaurant with 1 AM pickup closing listed all week.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant's official page lists pickup hours until 1 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Pan Am Restaurant — Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Pickup closes at 1 AM daily; opening is 2 PM Monday–Friday and 1 PM Saturday–Sunday.

cards.title: Hopsfrog Grille
cards.subtitle: 6030 L-1 Burke Commons Rd, Burke
cards.notes: Use the food menu and posted late schedule for a sit-down stop; check the day because weekend closing runs later.
cards.short_summary: A nearby family-friendly grille with 1 AM Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hopsfrog's official site describes it as family-friendly and lists closing at 11:30 PM most days and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11:30 PM closing Sunday–Thursday; 1 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 9929 Main St, Fairfax
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order early enough for the posted cutoff, particularly if you are ordering on a weekend.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfax pizza location with midnight Friday and Saturday carryout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists carryout and delivery until midnight Friday and Saturday, and 11 PM on other days.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are posted until 12 AM Friday–Saturday and 11 PM Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut at Village Shops Drive
cards.subtitle: 8902 Village Shops Drive, Fairfax Station
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout using the official site, and allow for the separate note that delivery hours may vary.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza stop with midnight service most nights and 1 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists delivery and carryout until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are posted until 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday; delivery hours may vary.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named Fairfax Campus spaces for making, studying, recreation, and student connection, each supported by a direct George Mason University source.

cards.title: Fenwick Library
cards.subtitle: Central Fairfax Campus research library
cards.notes: Set up for individual reading or a group work session, then use the library’s study-room system when your group needs a reservable room.
cards.short_summary: A central library with flexible study areas and group collaboration space.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick Library is Mason’s main research library on the Fairfax campus and offers learning spaces with modular furniture for individual study and group collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Located at 4400 University Dr, Fairfax; check the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fenwick Lobby
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Library’s north and south entrance level
cards.notes: Use the general study seating for a quick session, or reserve one of the five lobby study rooms through Mason Libraries’ room reservation system.
cards.short_summary: A lobby study area with reservable rooms at Fenwick Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenwick Lobby contains general study areas and five study rooms reservable through Mason Libraries’ room reservation system.
cards.source_title: Fenwick Library Tour - Fenwick Lobby | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Access is through Fenwick’s north or south entrances; confirm current library and lobby hours online.

cards.title: Mason Innovation Exchange (MIX)
cards.subtitle: Horizon Hall, ground floor
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and ask the front desk about maker tools, media-lab resources, workshops, or entrepreneurship support for your next step.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub combining making, media work, and venture support.
cards.evidence_claim: The MIX in Horizon Hall is a network of spaces supporting making, venture creation, and collaboration, including a makerspace, workshops, events, and an incubator.
cards.source_title: Signature Learning Spaces | George Mason University
cards.access_notes: MIX Front Desk: Horizon Hall 1408. Current summer hours are posted by the MIX; equipment and services may have separate requirements.

cards.title: George W. Johnson Center
cards.subtitle: 4477 Aquia Creek Lane
cards.notes: Use a lounge or study room between classes, and check the building directory for events and campus offices before heading upstairs.
cards.short_summary: A student center organized around lounges, study rooms, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Johnson Center offers study rooms, lounges, and event spaces where students gather outside class to share ideas and build campus community.
cards.access_notes: Standard building hours are 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily; tenant and event availability can vary.

cards.title: The Hub
cards.subtitle: 10423 Rivanna River Way
cards.notes: Meet collaborators in the common areas, then use the directory to locate Student Involvement, leadership programs, print services, or mail services.
cards.short_summary: A student-engagement center with meeting space and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub has meeting rooms and event spaces and houses Student Involvement, New Student and Family Programs, leadership and intercultural engagement, and student services offices.
cards.access_notes: Standard building hours are 7:30 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily; individual offices and spaces keep their own schedules.

cards.title: Corner Pocket Game Room
cards.subtitle: The Hub, middle level
cards.notes: Choose a table, arcade, video, or VR game with friends, and check the current games-and-rates page before planning a longer visit.
cards.short_summary: The Hub’s dedicated campus game room.
cards.evidence_claim: Corner Pocket is George Mason’s on-campus game room in The Hub, with games, programs, and tournaments.
cards.access_notes: The current summer schedule is Tuesday–Thursday, 4:00–9:00 p.m.; memberships and some games have charges.

cards.title: Side Pocket
cards.subtitle: Corner Pocket area, The Hub
cards.notes: Use this lounge-style space to gather before an event, or reserve it for an organization program when you need a stage, projector, and screen.
cards.short_summary: A Corner Pocket event space with presentation equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Side Pocket is one of the Corner Pocket spaces and includes a small stage, projector, screen, and tables and chairs for events.
cards.source_title: Corner Pocket Event Rentals | Student Centers
cards.access_notes: It is within The Hub; reservations require advance planning and carry published rental rates.

cards.title: Aquatic and Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: 4520 Patriot Circle
cards.notes: Check the facility schedule, then plan a workout, swim, or group fitness session using the listed cardio, strength, pool, and studio amenities.
cards.short_summary: A recreation facility with pools, fitness equipment, and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aquatic and Fitness Center offers cardio and strength equipment, fitness programs, a competition pool, recreation pool, and other aquatic amenities.
cards.source_title: Aquatic and Fitness Center | Mason Recreation
cards.access_notes: Access is for members; consult Mason Recreation’s current facility schedules and policies before visiting.

cards.title: Recreation and Athletic Complex (RAC)
cards.subtitle: Fairfax Campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Look at the current recreation schedule, then choose a gym, court, yoga room, or fitness area that fits your planned activity.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use recreation building for fitness and court activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The RAC includes weight and cardio equipment, a yoga room, self-defense room, two gymnasiums, and racquetball and squash courts.
cards.access_notes: Consult Mason Recreation for current operating hours, membership access, and activity schedules.

cards.title: Skyline Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Southside dining hall
cards.notes: Plan a cardio or weight session, try the indoor tread climbing wall, or check Outdoor Adventures offerings connected with the facility.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located fitness center with a gym and climbing wall.
cards.evidence_claim: Skyline Fitness Center is a centrally located campus facility adjacent to Southside dining hall with cardio and weight equipment, an indoor tread climbing wall, a full gymnasium, and Outdoor Adventures.
cards.access_notes: Consult Mason Recreation for current operating hours, membership access, and activity schedules.
